title: Compile-Time Units
description: Upgrade M06's units project with templates.
requirements: `template <int M, int Kg, int S> class Quantity` — exponents of meter, kg, second as non-type params
`operator*` adds exponents, `operator/` subtracts → `Quantity<1,0,-1>` is velocity automatically!
Aliases: `using Meters = Quantity<1,0,0>; using Newtons = Quantity<1,1,-2>;`
Adding mismatched units is a **compile error**
User-defined literals (`5.0_m`, `2.0_s`) — see [[13.06 Preprocessor and Attributes]]
